description: Playing-conditions timeline for the cricket simulator (CRICKET-MODEL-PLAN.md section 5). Layers apply in file order; a layer applies when every 'when' key matches and from <= date < until (ISO dates, null = open). Later layers override earlier ones field by field. 'source' says whether a value rests on memory of ICC/board playing conditions, on Cricsheet data, or both; reports/cricket-rules-validation.json checks every data-testable field and docs/cricket-rules.md explains each data-vs-memory conflict.

conventions.overs: 1-based inclusive over numbers in units of balls_per_over (The Hundred: 5-ball sets, as Cricsheet encodes it)
conventions.when_keys: fmt, gender, team_type, competition_id, tier, event_id, official, assoc_match (lists match any element; booleans match exactly), teams_any (at least one team listed), teams_all (every team listed), knockout (bool, from the Cricsheet event stage)
conventions.reviews_per_innings: unsuccessful player reviews per team per innings whenever DRS is in use; null when drs_scope is 'none'
conventions.drs_scope: all = every match; selected = some series or broadcast matches only (drs_available false by default); knockouts = playoff/knockout matches only; none = never

fields.overs_per_innings: scheduled overs per innings (limited overs; Hundred: twenty 5-ball sets)
fields.bowler_quota_overs: maximum overs per bowler per innings
fields.bowler_quota_balls: maximum legal balls per bowler per innings
fields.powerplay_overs: {mandatory: [[from, to], ...], batting: {n, overs, window, max_outside} | null, fielding: same | null}
fields.fielders_outside: [[from_over, to_over, max_fielders_outside_circle], ...] outside optional powerplay blocks
fields.noball_extra_runs: penalty runs for a no-ball (1, or 2 in English domestic competitions)
fields.drs_available: DRS in use for a typical match of this competition and date
fields.umpires_call_retains_review: an unsuccessful review that is umpire's call does not cost a review
fields.review_topup_after_80: Tests: reviews reset to the full allowance after 80 overs of an innings
fields.follow_on_lead: minimum first-innings lead to enforce the follow-on
fields.new_ball_after_overs: overs after which a new ball may be taken (multi-day)
fields.balls_in_use: one | two_new_balls (one from each end) | two_balls_until_34 (ODI: one of the two chosen for overs 35-50)
fields.super_over: none (ties stand) | bowl_out | single | repeat (until a winner) | knockout_only
fields.min_overs_for_result: overs each side must be able to face for a result (Hundred: 5-ball sets)
fields.max_consecutive_balls_per_end: Hundred: a bowler bowls 5 or 10 consecutive balls
fields.slow_over_rate_fielding_penalty: informational: in-match penalty of one fewer fielder outside the circle
fields.caught_crossing_counts: after a catch, batters who crossed stay crossed (the new batter may go to the non-striker's end); false = new batter always on strike (Law 18.11, October 2022)

layers.note: Data: every T20 competition records a 6-over mandatory powerplay and 20 overs; bowler maximum 24 legal balls; D/L results need 5 overs a side.
Data: the 2006 NZ v WI and 2007 India v Pakistan T20I ties were decided by bowl-outs; the first super over is 2008-12-26.
ICC October 2019: super overs repeat until there is a winner. Data: IPL 2020 and a 2025 T20I needed repeated super overs.
Data: on free-hit-eligible balls before July 2015, bowled/caught/lbw dismissals still occur at a quarter to a third of the base rate (T20I 0.24, IPL 0.33): height no-balls carried no free hit.
Data: zero protected dismissals on free-hit balls in T20Is and IPL from 2015.
Data 2005-2008: m1-10 plus two 5-over fielding powerplays (typically 11-15, 16-20).
Data 2009-2011: m1-10, one fielding block (often 11-15) and one batting block (often 43-50).
Data late 2011-2012: m1-10 f16-20 b36-40; no block starts before over 16 or ends after 40.

data_anomalies.explanation: Ireland v Pakistan 2018 (1127284) enforced with a lead of 180: day 1 was washed out, so Law 14.1.3 applied the four-day threshold of 150. The timeline does not model lost days; time_rain/tactics should.
The 2020 quarter-final Leicestershire v Nottinghamshire (match 1207789) is recorded as a tie with no super over.
One 2021/22 group match (1299613) went to a super over; the other CSA T20 group ties stood.
Bangladesh v India women, 2023-07-22 (1382168): tie with no super over played.
Scotland v Ireland in the 2018 Netherlands tri-series (1142504): tie with no super over.
One Quetta Gladiators innings (match 1168827) shows two failed reviews against a one-review allowance; every other 2019 team-innings has at most one. Treated as an untagged umpire's call.
Australia show three failed fielding reviews before over 80 of the West Indies second innings at Melbourne (match 892517); the allowance was two. Likely a mis-attributed or untagged review.
Australia show three failed fielding reviews before over 80 at Dhaka (match 1104284), a month before umpire's-call retention; likely a mis-attributed review.
Marsh Cup match 1322388 records a 19.5-over D/L target; the chase was set for 20 overs less one ball, treated as the 20-over minimum.
A single supersub-coded replacement in WBBL 2020/21; WBBL did not use the BBL X-factor rule, so it is treated as a non-tactical replacement.
